Grade: Grade 7

Topic 2.3: Preparing Animal Products • Eggs • Honey

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Preparing Animal Products • Eggs • Honey, part of Food Production Processes in Grade 7 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can we prepare animal products?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Integrity: use of ethically acceptable procedures in the preparation and packaging of eggs and honey.
